Review Title: Welcoming staff, professional communications, fun ride
Review Text:
Despite high winds and fog in the city, our group could see all of the sights clearly and had a great ride. A seaplane is such an exciting experience, even if you've flown in other light craft before. Each member of the staff we encountered were very friendly and cool, and made us feel very comfortable. We really felt welcomed.

The online booking experience was super smooth and user-friendly. Received reminder emails with all necessary information and even a text the morning of the flight letting us know that traffic would be heavier than normal and to plan accordingly.

The building was quite nice too, with a comfortable picnic table outside, sofas in a lounge inside, and clean restrooms. Highly recommend!

Review Title: Safe and Fun, Even With Pandemic and Without the Sun
Review Text: The weather was gray and wet but we were able to go up with Fred. We kept to the Bay and flew close to the GG Bridge and over the Bay Bridge. I was bummed that the weather kept us from going over the City, but Fred made the best of it, and we enjoyed our time in the sky. There's no better feeling than flying I can think of, besides my other favorite, being in water. It was my husband's first time in a small plane and he enjoyed the ride and views. Things were not so far away, especially since we were flying low because of the weather. A COVID note: Our temps were taken and the pilot disinfected the plane before we boarded, and all abroad wore masks. I could feel outside air moving through the cabin, too. I felt pretty comfortable and safe. Go flying and keep this awesome business afloat! (Get it?)
